about: Downloads the cu-driver eval verifies by sha256 before use. The cmux-cua arm is not here: it follows CMUX_CUA_RELEASE_TAG in scripts/build-cmux-cua.sh at the step's ref, checked against that release's SHA256SUMS.

image.name: trycua/macos-tahoe-cua
